title: Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding for Trustworthy LLM-Based Robot Planning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37554v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as high-level planners in robot navigation, but their outputs may become unreliable when instructions are ambiguous, unsupported by the environment, or semantically inconsistent. This paper presents a Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding framework for trustworthy LLM-based robot planning. Unlike existing LLM-based planners that primarily optimize plan generation, we formulate semantic grounding reliability as a multi-dimensional risk estimation problem. The proposed architecture explicitly models grounding uncertainty through ambiguity, hallucination and semantic-conflict risks before planning occurs, enabling the system to decide whether to execute the instruction, request clarification, or reject it. translated_title: 面向可信大语言模型机器人规划的风险感知语义接地框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在机器人导航中越来越多地被用作高层规划器，但当指令含糊不清、缺乏环境支持或语义不一致时，其输出可能变得不可靠。本文提出了一个面向可信大语言模型机器人规划的风险感知语义接地框架。与现有主要优化规划生成的基于LLM的规划器不同，我们将语义接地可靠性表述为一个多维风险估计问题。所提出的架构在规划执行之前，通过歧义、幻觉和语义冲突风险显式建模接地的不确定性，使系统能够决定是执行指令、请求澄清还是拒绝该指令。为了评估该方法，我们引入了TRUST-NAV基准，其中包含标准导航任务和风险诱导指令场景。实验结果表明，虽然传统的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个风险感知语义接地框架，将LLM机器人规划中的语义接地可靠性建模为多维风险估计问题，在规划前显式评估歧义、幻觉和语义冲突三类风险，使系统能够智能决策执行、请求澄清或拒绝指令，并引入TRUST-NAV基准验证其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding framework that formulates semantic grounding reliability as a multi-dimensional risk estimation problem—modeling ambiguity, hallucination, and semantic-conflict risks before planning—enabling LLM-based robot planners to decide whether to execute, request clarification, or reject instructions, evaluated through the TRUST-NAV benchmark.
